exec: A cyberattack hit the operating server and system at Peninsula Energy's Lance uranium project in Wyoming, and the company has not said how long the disruption will last.
geo_basis: state named in the source; map pin at the centre of Wyoming
plain: Peninsula Energy says a cyberattack hit the operating server and system at its Lance uranium project in Wyoming. Its administrative systems and corporate office were unaffected, and it has not said whether production stopped.
summary: The Northern Miner reports a cyberattack on Friday, 20 November hit the operating server and system at Peninsula Energy's Lance uranium project in Wyoming. CEO George Bauk told shareholders the administrative systems and corporate office were unaffected. The company has not said whether production stopped or how long the disruption will last, and it has not named the type of attack.
title: Peninsula Energy says cyberattack hit operating server at Lance uranium project in Wyoming
